title: Identity utilities
prompt: Implement `Initials` and `PasswordScore` as described. Initials uppercases each word's first letter and joins them; the password score has exactly three independent criteria.

tests.name: initials
tests.hint: Lowercase input must come out uppercase; blank inputs yield the empty string.

tests.name: password
tests.hint: Careful: the "Ab1" assertion expects 2 — it fails the length rule but earns digit and uppercase points.
